import Mathlib.Demo

open Mathlib.Demo

#eval greeting              -- "hello from Mathlib (stub)"
#eval double 21             -- 42
#check @double_zero         -- double 0 = 0

/-!

namespace Mathlib.Demo

def double (n : Nat) : Nat := n + n

theorem double_zero : double 0 = 0 := rfl

end Mathlib.Demo
